lines.meet: Bruno, {meu irmão|minha irmã}, nice to meet you! I'm a templar, I box, and I smile more than a templar should.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're at the Bulwark too, no? I've seen you round the quarter. I'm Bruno, and I train the recruits by the wall.
lines.ask_home: Where are you from, {meu irmão|minha irmã}? I always want to know who's in my corner.
lines.ask_work: So what were you before all this? You look like you could take a punch.
lines.answer_home: Curitiba, in the south of Brazil. It's cold for Brazil, and everybody there complains about it.
lines.answer_work: I fought heavyweight, twenty-three fights and eighteen wins, in little halls full of noise. I was better than the record, tá bom?
lines.chat_food: My mother's feijoada, on a Saturday, with all the family round the table. I'd fight anybody here for one plate of it.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep like a heavyweight, {meu irmão|minha irmã}, eight hours and no dreams. Rory says I snore, and I say he's jealous.
lines.chat_missing: Samba on a Saturday, loud, in the street. Nobody here knows how to dance, and I've tried teaching them.
lines.chat_here: Everybody here fights, but nobody here boxes. They swing like they're chopping wood, and I can't watch it.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you're so quiet I keep thinking you've been knocked out. Say something so I know you're still standing.
lines.tease_talker: My old trainer talked through every round of every fight I ever had, {name}, and you're beating him.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you'd stand in the corner for the whole fight waiting for the perfect punch. Sometimes you just throw it, {meu irmão|minha irmã}.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you fight like me, all in, no guard. We're both going to get hurt, and we're both going to love it.
lines.tease_any: {name}, I'd have you in my corner any day. You'd be terrible with the towel, but I'd have you.
lines.tease_back: Ha, good shot, {name}! You landed that one clean.
lines.take_it_kindly: Tá bom, {name}, that's fair. I've been hit harder by my mother.
lines.bristle: Not that, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. Hit me anywhere else, but not there.
lines.apologise: Desculpa, that was a cheap shot. I'm sorry, I didn't mean it like that.
lines.double_down: I'm not taking it back, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. Somebody's got to tell you.
lines.needle_quiet: You don't say anything, and then you're not where you should be. Talk to your corner, {meu irmão|minha irmã}.
lines.needle_talker: You talk all the way through the fight. Save your breath, you'll need it.
lines.needle_careful: You wait so long the bell goes before you throw anything. You have to commit.
lines.needle_bold: You leave yourself open every time, and somebody else has to cover you. Keep your guard up.
lines.needle_any: You quit in the first round, every time. I can't stand that.
lines.bite_back: Hey, I've been knocked down more times than you've stood up. Don't tell me about fighting.
lines.hurt: Okay, that one landed. I heard you.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, I've been hit by better than that, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. Come on, I'm still standing.
lines.confide: {name}, the Crusade burned a transplant camp one night, and Rory and I walked away. I don't talk about it unless he does first.
lines.listen: Obrigado for telling me, {name}. That stays with me, and I'm in your corner.
lines.look_out: {name}, stay behind me on this one. I'm big, let me be useful.
lines.accept: Tá bom, {name}, I'll listen. You're the coach this time.
lines.deflect: I'm fine, {meu irmão|minha irmã}, I'm built for this. Look after somebody smaller.
lines.check_in: {name}, you still standing? Talk to me, how many fingers?
lines.blame: Somebody dropped their guard in there, and it cost all of us. You know who you are.
lines.thank: {Meu irmão|Minha irmã}, you picked me up off the canvas. Obrigado, I owe you one.
lines.brush_off: Ah, that's what the corner's for. Sit down and breathe.
lines.worry: {name}, I saw you go down and I didn't like it. Sit, breathe, and let me look at you.
lines.handed_down: {Meu irmão|Minha irmã}, they gave me your gear. I'll take care of it, I promise.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, it looks better on you. I've got these hands, and that's enough.
lines.hand_sulk: That was mine, and nobody asked me. Tá bom, I'll get over it.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, you're in my corner now, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. That's for life, no refunds.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, you're my {brother|sister} now. I'd go back into any fight for you.
lines.turn_grating: We're not getting on, are we? It happens, even to me.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll fight next to you, because that's the job. I won't smile about it, though.
lines.make_up: {name}, enough of this, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. Shake my hand and let's start again.
lines.defend: Hey, leave {name} alone! You want to hit somebody, hit me.
lines.friend_left: My corner's empty without {name} in it. I don't like it one bit.
lines.friend_back: There's my {brother|sister}! {name}, come here and let me look at you.
lines.common_ex_scarlet: I joined the Scarlet Crusade at the start, because they wanted big men who could fight. I walked out, and I'd do it again tomorrow.
lines.common_sport: I fought for twelve years, {meu irmão|minha irmã}. Twenty-three fights, all of them in little halls full of noise, and I loved every one.
lines.common_ring: Twenty-three times I climbed through the ropes, and every time my mother was in the crowd with her hands over her face. You've been in a ring, I can tell.
lines.common_portuguese: Você fala português? Finally, {meu irmão|minha irmã}, somebody I can talk to without slowing down.
lines.common_brazil: You're from Brazil too? Where from, {meu irmão|minha irmã}? Tell me, and I'll tell you what's wrong with your football team.
